preconditions.description: n is the number of cities (4 ≤ n ≤ 1000) and k is the maximum allowed roads (n-1 ≤ k ≤ 2n-2).

preconditions.expression: 1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and 1 <= c <= n and 1 <= d <= n and a != b and c != d and {a, b, c, d}.issubset({1, 2, ..., n})
preconditions.description: a, b, c, d are distinct cities numbered from 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: a != c and a != d and b != c and b != d
preconditions.description: The pairs (a, b) and (c, d) are disjoint (no city is shared between them).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (len(stdout.splitlines()) == 2 and all(len(line.split()) == n for line in stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: Output is either '-1' or two lines, each containing exactly n distinct integers.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != '-1' and (stdout.splitlines()[0].split()[0] == str(a) and stdout.splitlines()[1].split()[0] == str(c))
postconditions.description: First path starts with city a, second path starts with city c.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != '-1' and (stdout.splitlines()[0].split()[-1] == str(b) and stdout.splitlines()[1].split()[-1] == str(d))
postconditions.description: First path ends with city b, second path ends with city d.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != '-1' and len(set(stdout.splitlines()[0].split())) == n and len(set(stdout.splitlines()[1].split())) == n
postconditions.description: Each path contains all n cities exactly once (no duplicates).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != '-1' and all(int(stdout.splitlines()[0].split()[i]) != int(stdout.splitlines()[0].split()[i+1]) for i in range(n-1)) and all(int(stdout.splitlines()[1].split()[i]) != int(stdout.splitlines()[1].split()[i+1]) for i in range(n-1))
postconditions.description: Adjacent cities in each path are distinct (no self-loops).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != '-1' and len(set((int(stdout.splitlines()[0].split()[i]), int(stdout.splitlines()[0].split()[i+1])) for i in range(n-1)) | set((int(stdout.splitlines()[1].split()[i]), int(stdout.splitlines()[1].split()[i+1])) for i in range(n-1))) <= k
postconditions.description: Total distinct roads in both paths combined do not exceed k.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != '-1' and (int(stdout.splitlines()[0].split()[0]), int(stdout.splitlines()[0].split()[1])) not in {(int(stdout.splitlines()[1].split()[i]), int(stdout.splitlines()[1].split()[i+1])) for i in range(n-1)} and (int(stdout.splitlines()[1].split()[0]), int(stdout.splitlines()[1].split()[1])) not in {(int(stdout.splitlines()[0].split()[i]), int(stdout.splitlines()[0].split()[i+1])) for i in range(n-1)}
postconditions.description: No direct road exists between a and b, or between c and d (as per problem statement).
